video_title: WAKE UP, WASHINGTON! 🗣️ Chiney says it's WINNING TIME for Wizards & Anthony Davis | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Will Dawkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Dawkins on building the Wizards around Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: the DC wants to be in DC, we're going to keep him there
quotes.quote: If the DC wants to be in DC, we're going to keep him there. I think the important thing for us is just building on the summer and making sure we're ready to go at the beginning of the year. He was out here with all of our guys. We had every single one of our team members here for game one. So we had all 17 guys on the roster here and he was a big part of what we had going on, working out, leading the group workouts for our veteran players. So it'll be a fun summer.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike calls for a new winning era in Washington
quotes.excerpt: It's time to win. And I know that the Eastern Conference right now is an arms race
quotes.quote: Washington, it's time to wake up. It's winning time, finally, please Lord. Because it has been since the last time the Wizards won 50 games, 1979. The last time they won a playoff series, 2017. The last time they were in the playoffs, 2021. It's time to win. And I know that the Eastern Conference right now is an arms race, but when you look at their roster, you need a big three in a different way, especially when you have Anthony Davis coming in at the literal three and D position that can bring in an influx of accountability and just passion for the game. You have Trae Young, an all-NBA type of point guard. He's always up there with scoring and assists, and you potentially have Anthony Davis as a center. We know what he's capable of. This is a solid roster to get wins.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins urges Anthony Davis to embrace his Washington tenure
quotes.excerpt: this is a moment for him to be selfish. Selfish in a way that you want to find a home
quotes.quote: For Anthony Davis, this is a moment for him to be selfish. Selfish in a way that you want to find a home. If I'm Anthony Davis, I embrace this situation. I would actually go to Rich Paul, his agent, and tell him, I'm not looking to get traded to any other destination. No, I want to be in Washington. I want to show the world that I'm still AD. AD when healthy is still a top 10 to top 15 player in this league. He's still a guy that could go out there and is going to give you 25 points, 12 rebounds, and two blocks a night. And so again, AD, I don't want to look at him on the back part of his career and look at him as a journeyman.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Lowe on the financial reality of Anthony Davis in Washington
quotes.excerpt: the reason that he's in Washington is because the Mavericks didn't want to deal with this discussion
quotes.quote: Let's be honest, the reason that he's in Washington is because the Mavericks didn't want to deal with this discussion about he wants an extension. And it's not just that he wants an extension, he wants a massive extension, a max or near max type of extension. That's why he went to Washington. That's why there wasn't much of a market for him before the trade deadline last year and the Wizards didn't have to give up a whole lot to get him. There is real pressure on the front office in Washington to produce a winner right now and the last thing they need is some kind of black cloud hanging over AD because you can't get on the same page in terms of how he fits for the future financially.
